name: Morphology-to-Resource Coupling
purpose: Make realized developmental morphology pay explicit bounded resource benefits and costs without modifying accepted P1 resource truth, so morphology can later participate in selection instead of being presentation-only.
coupling_boundary: accepted PlantResourceModel result is immutable parent evidence; PH3 produces a separate research-only morphology ledger and coupled balance
acceptance_semantics: accepted P1 resource checksum remains exact and is referenced, not rewritten
height increases shade light-access benefit and super-linear structural cost
crown spread increases light capture and drought water cost
branching increases light capture and construction/maintenance cost
extreme giant dense morphology gains gross benefit but loses net morphology balance to the balanced form
same inputs replay to exact coupling hashes
renderer/mesh/LOD are absent from coupling truth
no TREE/BUSH/GRASS canonical class is introduced
next_after_acceptance: ECO.PH3C Morphology-Aware Selection / Competition Convergence, then ECO.PH4 Seed Development Lifecycle
